subject: [PATCH v2 8/8] memcg: simplify v1 event ratelimiting

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the v1 event ratelimiting in the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) by collapsing multiple periodic events into a single counter. The target enum, per-cpu target array, and switch in memcg1_event_ratelimit() are all reduced to a single threshold counter. This change also removes the need for a node ID in memcg1_check_events(), allowing it to drop its nid argument and related struct changes. The patch aims to improve code simplicity and reduce complexity by eliminating unnecessary variables and logic.
